notes.title: Layer Tabs Update: Enhanced Preview and Renaming
notes.content: Now, the layer tabs for the crosshairs display a small preview to help you identify them clearly. You can also rename layers by double-clicking or right-clicking the tab. Additionally, when you hover over a tab, it will be highlighted on the designer's canvas, making it easier to identify.

notes.title: Export crosshairs as PNG images
notes.content: Added functionality to export crosshairs as PNG images.
